summary: Pass under the PM round cap only. All eleven test files pass. Six findings are fixed. F13, F15, and new F20 remain nonblocking.
nonblocking_findings: F13 [Major] review-a: Partially fixed, but the call still lacks the specified deadline. review-run.sh:1057 and :1242-1288 impose a separate ten-second empty window. The judge copies that rule at judge-run.sh:805 and :990-1036. My queued-answer fixture refused after 10.79 seconds with a 30-second budget and an answer due at 11 seconds. Another fixture accepted completion after 2.72 seconds with a one-second budget. Complete replies bypass the deadline check, and each request receives a fresh timeout. Empty probes still become reachable without a model answer. Use one deadline from call entry and wait through that deadline. Route to Green.

F15 [Major] review-a: Open. Pilot routes still enter isolated seeding when BENCH_SERVER_BASE is unset at review-run.sh:365 and judge-run.sh:317. The default applies only to an explicitly empty value. The F15 test at review-run.test.ts:5365 tests empty, not unset. Both supplied drivers still omit the variable on this HEAD. The promised exports address those callers once verified, but they do not make the runner fail closed. D14 still prohibits pilot seeding. Refuse an unset pilot base and move isolated fixtures to non-pilot routes. Route the guard to Green and the driver exports to the orchestrator.

F20 [Major] review-a: New. Both synthesizers select the oldest assistant from a native newest-first message page. review-run.sh:1192-1196 and judge-run.sh:940-944 overwrite last for every assistant. OpenChamber context-obligatory/runtime.js:88 documents newest-first ordering. My full runner fixture supplied FINAL first and EARLY second. It stored EARLY, recorded the older token bundle, and marked the pass complete. Both extracted readers also waited on an older partial message while a newer final answer already existed. Select the newest terminal answer and preserve the call's token sums. Add ordered multi-message cases for both runners. Route to Green.
